description: Self-signed certificate guide (docs/CERTIFICATE.md) and Makefile signing identity variable
steps: Create docs/CERTIFICATE.md with step-by-step instructions to create a self-signed code signing certificate named 'Ledge Dev' in Keychain Access (5 steps, with description of what to do in each screen)
Update Makefile: add SIGNING_IDENTITY ?= Ledge Dev variable near the top (after CONFIG and APP_NAME vars)

Change the codesign line in the `app` target from `codesign --force --sign - "$(BUNDLE)"` to `codesign --force --sign "$(SIGNING_IDENTITY)" "$(BUNDLE)"` with a comment showing how to use ad-hoc: `make app SIGNING_IDENTITY="-"`
Update the `reset-permission` target comment to note it is only needed with ad-hoc signing (when using a stable certificate the grant persists across rebuilds)
acceptance_criteria: Makefile has SIGNING_IDENTITY variable defaulting to 'Ledge Dev'
codesign command uses $(SIGNING_IDENTITY) instead of hardcoded '-'
Running `swift test` still passes all 54 tests (Makefile change does not break anything)
verification: Run `swift test` and confirm all 54 tests pass
findings: All 54 tests pass. Makefile changes are purely in the app/codesign targets which only apply on macOS; swift test on Linux is unaffected.
